factual_claims.claim: Activation-based safety probes trained on WildGuardMix show performance degradation when evaluated on datasets with different labeling rubrics, such as ToxicChat or OpenAI-moderation.
Tensor Polynomial Classifiers (TPCs) achieve lower latency than Early-Exit MLPs at small batch sizes and converge to similar performance at medium/large batch sizes.
Symmetric CP factorization reduces parameter counts for higher-order tensor weights without sacrificing performance compared to non-symmetric factorization.

TPC (Test-time Probe Computation) achieves competitive F1 scores on harmful prompt classification compared to MLP probes, bilinear probes, and EE-MLP baselines across WildGuard and BeaverTails datasets.
